name: pr-review-gate
description: Collect pull request details via form, gate on reviewer approval or rejection, then emit a formal review record.

steps.description: Reviewer must approve or reject the PR before the record is written.
steps.prompt: Review PR '{{collect-pr.title}}' by {{collect-pr.author}} (risk: {{collect-pr.risk}}). Approve or reject.

steps.description: Emit the formal PR review record.
steps.run:
jq -r '
  "## PR Review Record\n" +
  "**Title:** " + (."collect-pr".title // "(untitled)") + "\n" +
  "**Author:** " + (."collect-pr".author // "?") + "\n" +
  "**Risk:** " + (."collect-pr".risk // "?") + "\n" +
  "**Reviewer:** " + (.inputs.reviewer // "?") + "\n" +
  "**Decision:** " + (."gate-review".decision // "?") +
  if (."collect-pr".url // "") != "" then
    "\n**URL:** " + ."collect-pr".url
  else "" end
' <<< "$OSL_CONTEXT" | jq -Rs '{review_record: .}'
